name: Blood Of Jesus
overview: Scripture reveals the blood of Jesus as central to the new covenant, providing atonement and forgiveness of sins through His sacrificial death. The Old Testament establishes the significance of blood in making atonement for the soul, while the New Testament affirms that Jesus' blood was shed for many to bring remission of sins and redemption. Believers are justified and saved from wrath by His blood, which also serves as the means by which the church is purchased and sustained. This profound truth underscores the grace and mercy extended to humanity through Christ's sacrificial offering.
